title: 2026 Sanlam Cape Town Marathon official route profile and landmarks (WEBP)
claims: The profile runs from DHL Stadium at 0 km to DHL Stadium at 42.2 km.
The profile gives a start elevation of 11 m, a highest point of 41 m and a lowest point of 8 m.
The profile gives 215 m of total ascent and 209 m of total descent.
The profile gives 21 km of total uphill running, 20 km of total downhill running and 1 km of total flat running.
The profile labels four terrain zones: gentle opening rollers at 3–10 km, a long steady middle at 13–30 km, a primary climb at 31–32 km, and a gradual 10 km descent to the finish.
The profile labels Rondebosch Common at the highest point of the curve.

The profile labels V&A Waterfront view, CTICC and Westin Grand, Table Mountain view, Groote Schuur, Baxter Theatre, Presidential Estate, Red Cross Children's Hospital, Old Biscuit Mill, Castle Street, Castle of Good Hope, City Hall, St George's Cathedral, South African Museum, Sea Point Pavilion Pools and Mouille Point Lighthouse view.
